messages.content: User task: Convert 42 degrees Fahrenheit to Celsius.

raw_response:
To convert 42 °F to Celsius, subtract 32 then multiply by 5⁄9: (42 − 32) × 5⁄9 = 10 × 5⁄9 ≈ 5.56 °C.

PLAN: Subtract 32 from 42 → 10  
PLAN: Multiply 10 by 5⁄9 → 5.555…  
PLAN: Round to two decimal places → 5.56 °C
